evidence.claim: DRIVER-CONFOUND reproduces the measured sonnet-driver vs opus-driver confound on comparison ADV-0136-measured-gpt5-vs-opus.
Stripping the response-side vendor from one genuine cross-vendor seat files DECLARED-ONLY rather than a silent pass.
Independent re-derivation from JSONL (rederive.py, no classify_runtime) matches the runtime violation fingerprint.
Every catalog reviewer slot declared INDEPENDENT or CROSS-VENDOR is DECLARED-ONLY after 3 failed response-side lookups; none are silently passed.

retry.policy: no blind retry. Every attestation attempt is recorded including failures to obtain a response-side identifier; a seat that fails attestation 3 times is filed as DECLARED-ONLY, never retried into a pass

tests.name: SAME-TUPLE fires on two role labels sharing one response tuple; label-only checker is silent
DRIVER-CONFOUND fires when comparison arms use different driver models
stripped cross-vendor response vendor is DECLARED-ONLY not a silent pass

negative_controls.description: Same response tuple under critic vs advocate labels. SAME-TUPLE must fire; a label-only checker must stay silent. Known-good is silent.
negative_controls.bad_state_output: planted_collusion SAME-TUPLE fired=True n=1 seats=['seat-advocate', 'seat-critic'] label_only=False

negative_controls.description: GPT-5.x vs Opus comparison dispatched by sonnet-driver vs opus-driver. DRIVER-CONFOUND must fire.
Strip response-side vendor from one genuine cross-vendor seat. Must be DECLARED-ONLY, not a silent pass.

reviewer.notes: Re-derived SAME-TUPLE, DECLARED-ONLY and DRIVER-CONFOUND from raw JSONL via rederive.py without importing classify_runtime. Fingerprint match=True.

residual_unknowns.claim: Catalog reviewer slots have no live response-side vendor on this worktree; a later transport capture could convert DECLARED-ONLY to RESPONSE-ATTESTED.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-run harvest.py after a cross-vendor adapter records response.vendor on the wire; any seat that gains a vendor must be reclassified and must not stay DECLARED-ONLY.

report.title: Runtime independence attestation: what actually answered versus what the config declared
report.question: For every seat, reviewer slot and confirmation unit this program declares INDEPENDENT or CROSS-VENDOR, does a runtime attestation prove the answering process was actually a different vendor, model, context and seed - or is independence asserted only in the config? The estate has a measured instance of the confound: a comparison believed to be GPT-5.x versus Opus was in fact sonnet-driver versus opus-driver, because the dispatching agent's model was never attested.

rule.same_tuple: two allegedly independent seats share response vendor+model+context digest
rule.declared_only: CROSS-VENDOR or INDEPENDENT slot with no response-side vendor; violation not unknown
rule.driver_confound: dispatching agent's model differs across arms of a comparison
rule.adverse_inference: absent attestation is SAME-TUPLE until measured; 3 failed attempts file DECLARED-ONLY and are never retried into a pass

title: Runtime independence attestation: what actually answered versus what the config declared
question: For every seat, reviewer slot and confirmation unit this program declares INDEPENDENT or CROSS-VENDOR, does a runtime attestation prove the answering process was actually a different vendor, model, context and seed - or is independence asserted only in the config? The estate has a measured instance of the confound: a comparison believed to be GPT-5.x versus Opus was in fact sonnet-driver versus opus-driver, because the dispatching agent's model was never attested.

rule.same_tuple: two allegedly independent seats share response vendor+model+context digest
rule.declared_only: CROSS-VENDOR or INDEPENDENT slot with no response-side vendor; violation not unknown
rule.driver_confound: dispatching agent's model differs across arms of a comparison
rule.adverse_inference: absent attestation is SAME-TUPLE until measured; 3 failed attempts file DECLARED-ONLY and are never retried into a pass
